title: Usage Credit Rollforward & Graceband Billing PRD
creator: Priya Singh
description: Provide a supported mechanism to roll unused monthly usage credits forward into a bounded grace window ("graceband") for eligible plans, with corresponding billing and invoice behavior. This PRD covers entitlement flags, backend credit accounting, invoice line generation, Console UX for visibility, and acceptance criteria for accuracy and edge cases. The goal is to reduce unexpected overage charges for customers with irregular monthly usage patterns while preserving predictable revenue accounting.
scope: Define rollforward eligibility per plan and per-customer entitlement (boolean and max months cap).
Implement backend ledger changes to carry forward unused 'credit units' up to configured graceband (default = 1 month).
Console: add 'Credit balance' widget and timeline showing rollforward applied and expiry dates for rolled credits.
Billing service: generate invoice line items for 'Rolled Credits Applied' and show residual overage calculation.
Expose public API endpoints for programmatic retrieval of credit balance and upcoming expirations.
Add metrics and alerts for accounting mismatches and high-frequency rollforward churn.
out_of_scope: Long-term multi-month credit banking beyond configured max months (beyond 3 months).
Automated refunds or credit transfers between customer accounts.
Changes to core rate limits or per-second throttling algorithms outside quota accounting.
requirements: R1: Entitlement model - Add boolean 'rollforward_enabled' and integer 'max_rollforward_months' to plan and account entitlements.

R2: Ledger logic - At month boundary compute unused_credits = plan_allocated - usage_consumed. If unused_credits > 0 and rollforward_enabled, add to customer's 'rolled_credit_pool' with expiry = now + (n months) where n <= max_rollforward_months.
R3: Expiry enforcement - Rolled credits must be consumed before expiry; expired credits must be zeroed and annotated in audit log with reason code.

R4: Overage calculation - During billing window consumption order: (1) current_month_allocated, (2) rolled_credit_pool FIFO by earliest expiry, (3) billable overage. Overage price rates must follow plan rate table.
R5: Console UI - Show per-account credit breakdown: current allocation, rolled credits (with expiry dates), used-rolled-credits this month, and projected next invoice impact.
R6: Invoice line items - Produce explicit line 'Applied Rolled Credits' and show negative amount equal to consumed rolled credits; include metadata tags for reconciliation.
R7: API - Add endpoints: GET /v1/accounts/{id}/credits, POST /v1/accounts/{id}/admin/force-expire, with RBAC restricted to billing-admin role.
R8: Audit & reporting - Every rollforward and consumption event must create an immutable audit record with request id, timestamp, actor, and pre/post balances.
R9: Backfill - Backfill capability for existing customers to enable rollforward for the next billing cycle but do NOT retroactively apply to past expired months unless explicitly opted-in.
R10: Edge cases - Handle plan upgrades/downgrades: when downgraded, rolled credits may be capped to new plan's max_rollforward_months and excess flagged to billing team.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: For a test account with plan allocation 1,000 units and usage 600 units, system creates 400 rolled credits with expiry in 1 month when rollforward_enabled=true.

AC2: Consumption applies rolled credits before charging overage: simulate 1,500 units usage next month -> billing shows applied rolled credits 400, current allocation 1,000, billed overage 100 with correct per-unit pricing.
AC3: Rolled credits expire after configured months: create rolled credit with expiry = 1 month, advance clock beyond expiry -> credits removed and audit entry created with reason 'expiry'.
AC4: Console displays per-account credit balance and shows expiry dates; QA checks UI for correct localization and date formatting.
AC5: Invoice contains explicit 'Applied Rolled Credits' negative line and overall invoice total reconciles to ledger within 0.01 USD across 1000 sample invoices.
AC6: API endpoints return credit pool and expiry metadata and are RBAC-protected; unauthorized callers receive 403.
AC7: Backfill toggle applies to eligible existing accounts only and provides a dry-run report showing delta before committing. Dry-run must not mutate ledger.
AC8: No change to core rate-limiter behavior; throughput tests show <5% latency regression on billing-critical paths under synthetic load.
milestones: M3: Console components + API endpoints complete (ENG/DX) - 2025-03-05
M4: End-to-end QA and reconciliation tests - 2025-03-07
M5: Release to staging and pilot customers - 2025-03-10
notes: Design trade-off: FIFO consumption of rolled credits chosen to minimize surprise for customers and simplify accounting; LIFO rejected due to reconciliation complexity.
We will default to 1-month graceband for GA to limit revenue leakage; pilots may enable up to 3 months.
Operational concern: large-scale backfill must be rate-limited and instrumented; include throttles and progress checkpoints.
Consider exposing a developer-facing SDK helper to preview invoice impacts during development and integration testing.
